update_text: Abyss floors now auto-advance, no more tapping NEXT! The Abyss also gets tougher past floor 30. Update now!
title: MERGE & CLOUD SAVE
message: New in 1.2: merge 3 spare items into 1 of the next rarity (5 Epics make a Legendary), or hit MERGE ALL in your bag. Your progress now backs up to Google Play Games too, so you can carry on if you change phones. Abyss floors now auto-advance as well. Thanks for playing!
